positions.name: MarkdownTimingVisibility
positions.frame: When should a price change take effect, so that buyers can still reach the discounted goods and can see the price before they choose to buy?
positions.why: Both statements settle one pricing practice: the half-price markdown moves to two in the afternoon, and the shelf card changes at the same time. src-1 times the markdown so buyers still have stock to purchase, and src-2 times the card so the price is known before the till. The two justifications rest on different goods, sell-through for buyers and predictability at the till, but both hold the same timing decision in one frame. No existing position was supplied to consult.
